title: Catalyst "competitor" study: discover other DAOs and voting mechanisms with the focus on improvements

ms.promise:
The first milestone is the research of these 3 DAOs:
・https://aragon.org
・https://daostack.io
・https://colony.io

About each DAO there will be published at least 1 research paper. 
This study will become later part of a book, published about DAO.
Adding response to the Reviewer: 
1 . "Research paper" will be a document that analyzes particular DAO: its technical characteristic (i.e. on which blockchain it's built), its ecosystem (i.e. number of dapps, users), its goals and plans, the mechanics of voting. Special attention will be paid to comparison with Catalyst. Main question is how this DAO functions, how it differs with Catalyst and what are the pros and cons of this DAO. A minimum viable length, I think will be 3000 words, but of course it might be longer. 
2 . If one of the named DAOs proves to be an unsuitable research subject? - All these DAOs in this milestone and in others are suitable and well-known (of course in the DAO circles, as DAOs as notion and trend is still at the very early days)
ms.criteria:
Each DAO research paper will be article published on Cryptotexty.io and other resources (15+ crypto-blogs) 
So the community will be able to see the results and take part in the communication
